title: Pure War Rock
summary: War Rock cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Rank 5s, Links and staples. War Rocks are EARTH Warriors that get stronger every time one of them battles: each battle trigger also gives all War Rocks 200 ATK until the end of the opponent's turn. War Rock Fortia searches a War Rock after battle. Orpis mills an EARTH Warrior, Mammud destroys a Spell/Trap, and Skyler and Bashileos summon more War Rocks mid-battle. Gactos summons itself next to a Normal Summoned EARTH Warrior. Many of them pull a Level 5 or higher War Rock from the Deck when the opponent sends them to the GY. War Rock Mountain searches a War Rock and summons one at the start of the Battle Phase. War Rock Medium, the newest card, Sets a War Rock Spell/Trap from the Deck. With a big War Rock out, it stops all monster effects on the field in Main Phase 1. War Rock Dignity negates an effect.
